general_ui_ux_design_guidelines.testing_attribute_requirement: All interactive buttons, inputs, modals, tabs, links, and cards MUST contain data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='admin-login-submit-button').
general_ui_ux_design_guidelines.contrast_rule: Maintain APCA contrast ratio >= 4.5:1. Never use transparent backgrounds on headers, dropdowns, or active cards.
general_ui_ux_design_guidelines.hover_state_rule: Every hover state must explicitly define text color and background color to avoid invisible contrast states.
general_ui_ux_design_guidelines.touch_targets: Minimum touch target size 44x44px for mobile views.
